fill_10.note: absent quarter read as 10 prescriptions instead of zero

fill_5.note: absent quarter read as 5 prescriptions instead of zero

note: Each row changes one element of the specification. The last row is the specification reported in the paper.

persistence_window.note: Events whose t+12 falls beyond the panel are evaluated on a shorter persistence window. The rule is the same; the follow-up available to it is not.

suppression_sensitivity.note: Three readings of an absent quarter: none dispensed, five prescriptions, and ten, which is the most the suppression threshold allows. The published specification is the first.
